Senior Full-Stack Developer

Own features across our TypeScript/React front end and API back end — from procurement workflows to multi-currency invoicing.

EngineeringAnkara / RemoteFull-time

What you'll do

  • Design and ship product features end-to-end across the web app and API
  • Model complex ERP domains — inventory, accounting, disbursement accounts — into clean, reliable code
  • Review code, raise the engineering bar, and mentor mid-level developers
  • Work directly with customers and support to turn feedback into product

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years building production web applications
  • Strong TypeScript plus React and Node.js (or similar) experience
  • Solid grasp of relational data modeling and API design
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous problems in a small team; English working proficiency
